prompt: Which of these patterns match the text `backup-02` as a whole? Select all that apply.
explain: `?` is exactly one character, so `backup-0?` matches `backup-02` but `backup-?` would need a one-character tail. `back*` and `*-02` match with `*` absorbing the rest or the start. `backup` has no wildcard and must equal the whole text.
